fact.content: live_cli.py's promote_artifact operation has no distinctly-named-path parameter for the four canonical phase artifacts -- evidence_io.CANONICAL_FILENAMES is a fixed phase->filename map with no override, so it always writes to the plain canonical name (e.g. verification-report.json) and refuses (EvidenceCollisionError) if that path already exists. work/SKILL.md's 'Same-run logic-failure route-back to the Engineer' section documents promoting a repair round's artifacts to a distinctly-named path (e.g. implementation-report.repair-1.json / verification-report.repair-1.json), but this convention cannot currently be executed through the live bridge as implemented -- confirmed by a real EvidenceCollisionError when run-20260917-logicrepair-002's resumed process attempted to promote a second verification-report.json.
